description: CYPRESS (Contextual Yield Protocol for Routed Expert Seed Systems) — a project- and vendor-agnostic multi-agent seed for AI coding tools. Drop it into any repo to give agents a large number of  per-role expert team, named protocols, a progressive-discovery knowledge graph, and spec- and test-driven discipline by default.
